$comment: Logical binding between OM group policy state (GroupControlState) and MLS epoch transitions. GroupControlTransition is the logical union of GroupControlIntent and GroupCommitBinding (ADR-0128 rule 21).

GroupControlTransition.previous_mls_epoch: MLS epoch expected by the transition
GroupControlTransition.resulting_group_state_hash: canonical resulting OM group-policy state hash
GroupControlTransition.conversation_id: stable Room ConversationID; the same provider-independent ID used by ConversationEvent

Rule: Membership-affecting OM state and MLS state may not silently commit independently.

GroupControlIntent.previous_group_state_hash: GroupControlState hash the intent was authorized against
GroupControlIntent.operation: membership/role/policy operation; key from om-room-capabilities.json operations
GroupControlIntent.reducing: true for reductions (ADR-0122 rule 1, ADR-0128 rule 1)
GroupControlIntent.authorization: capability grant evidence at the parent state, or SpaceDelegatedIntent evidence (Space signed evidence + Space head)
GroupControlIntent.dedup_key: for automatic device adds: (AccountID, device_id, ACS generation)

GroupCommitBinding.intent_hash: hash of the GroupControlIntent it carries
GroupCommitBinding.committer: coordinator, or a direct committer after sequencing_timeout for a reducing intent

LivenessRule: GroupControlState records coordinator_succession[]. After the GroupProfile sequencing_timeout, any member holding the authorizing capability may commit a pending reducing intent (removing a revoked or quarantined device needs none) and the coordinator's replacement, which is the next live device in the succession order. The coordinator never sequences its own removal or replacement. A rebased non-reducing intent is re-validated at its new parent and dropped if it fails (ADR-0128 rule 1).
